name: Grandfather's Gardeners
inspire: After an Action step, if a friendly fighter is vulnerable, Inspire that fighter.
generalRules:
In the Muster Warbands step of 'Setting Up', place a generic token on the 'Start' space of this warscroll's tracker. Advance that token 1 space clockwise immediately:

- after your turn.
- after damage is inflicted on a friendly fighter.
- after your turn if your warband holds more treasure tokens than your opponent.

Tracker spaces, clockwise from Start: 1 (Start), 1, Round Number, 2, 2 (see {icon:surge} Reap a Harvest), 3, 2.

reactions.name: Blooming Plague
reactions.rulesText: Where a friendly fighter has the Gardener ({icon:gardener}) runemark instead of a characteristic, {icon:gardener} is equal to the current space on your tracker.

reactions.name: Imperturbable
reactions.rulesText: No more than 2 damage can be inflicted on Uninspired friendly fighters in the same turn.

reactions.name: Reap a Harvest
reactions.trigger: Use this immediately after placing your token on this space.
reactions.rulesText: Pick a friendly fighter. Heal that fighter.

playstyle: Five slow Nurgle gardeners: four sturdy Move 3 bodies and a fragile flying Squort. Most of their damage is set by a tracker that advances after each turn, whenever a friendly fighter is hurt and when they hold more treasure, so attacks grow harder-hitting as the game goes on, and one tracker space heals a fighter. Imperturbable caps damage on Uninspired fighters at 2 per turn, and fighters Inspire once vulnerable. The warband wins by sitting on treasure, absorbing punishment and outlasting opponents in a late-game grind.
